items.title: Thorn and Zumtobel light the future of learning at Coláiste na Mí
items.summary: Thorn and Zumtobel supplied a phased lighting scheme for a new Irish secondary school, covering classrooms, social spaces and specialist facilities with an emphasis on flexibility and efficiency across the multi-building campus.

items.title: Glamox wins contract to light Formosa 4 wind farm in Taiwan
items.summary: Glamox will supply over 900 marine luminaires for up to 35 turbine foundations at Taiwan's Formosa 4 offshore wind farm, a large-scale application of corrosion-resistant lighting for renewable energy infrastructure.
